facts.fact: A senior care move-in decision can take anywhere from 48 hours (post-hospitalization) to two years (planned transitions), according to the AdWave article.
facts.quote: a decision that can take anywhere from 48 hours (post-hospitalization) to two years (planned transitions)

facts.fact: AdWave states that a single senior care resident often represents $4,000-$8,000 in monthly revenue.
facts.quote: a single resident often represents $4,000-$8,000 in monthly revenue and a multi-year stay

facts.fact: AdWave's example calculation puts one move-in at $120,000-$180,000 in lifetime revenue, based on $5,000 monthly revenue and a two-to-three-year stay.
facts.quote: one move-in represents $120,000-$180,000 in lifetime revenue

facts.fact: AdWave describes spending $1,500-$4,000 in blended advertising cost per move-in as healthy for senior care communities.
facts.quote: spending $1,500-$4,000 in blended advertising cost per move-in is healthy

facts.fact: AdWave reports that $8-30 per click is routine for Google Ads search terms such as "assisted living near me" in senior care.
facts.quote: $8-30 per click is routine

facts.fact: AdWave suggests expecting $1,500-$3,500 monthly to produce consistent signal from Google Ads search in senior care.
facts.quote: Expect $1,500-$3,500 monthly to produce consistent signal

facts.fact: According to AdWave, senior care referral platforms commonly charge referral fees equal to one full month of rent or a sizable placement fee per move-in.
facts.quote: referral fees commonly equal one full month of rent or a sizable placement fee per move-in

facts.fact: AdWave identifies adult children aged 45-65 as Facebook's core senior care decision-maker demographic.
facts.quote: The 45-65 adult-child decision-maker is Facebook's core demographic

facts.fact: AdWave says Meta/Facebook targeting by geography and age band can reach plausible families for $500-$1,500 a month.
facts.quote: for $500-$1,500 a month

facts.fact: AdWave states that typical CTV rates run $15-35 CPM with zip-code targeting around a community's draw radius.
facts.quote: typical CTV rates run $15-35 CPM with zip-code targeting around your draw radius

facts.fact: AdWave recommends $800-$2,500 monthly to sustain connected TV presence across a typical senior care service area.
facts.quote: $800-$2,500 monthly sustains presence across a typical service area

facts.fact: AdWave, a vendor, claims AI-generated TV creative from a website takes about two minutes and subscriptions start from $50.
facts.quote: With AI generation from your website taking about two minutes and subscriptions from $50

facts.fact: AdWave says the full effect of TV advertising in senior care reads out over two to three quarters because of long planned-transition cycles.
facts.quote: TV's full effect reads out over two to three quarters

facts.fact: AdWave states that community events and open houses typically cost $200-$800 per event.
AdWave's sample budget for a community investing $5,000-$8,000 monthly in paid channels allocates 35% to Google Ads, 25% to CTV, 15% to Meta, 15% to events, and 10% to directories.
facts.quote: For a community investing $5,000-$8,000 monthly in paid channels

facts.fact: AdWave's claim that consumers trust TV ads at roughly twice the rate of social ads is not attributed to a named third-party source in the article.
facts.unit: ratio of trust, TV vs social ads
facts.quote: Consumers report trusting TV ads at roughly twice the rate of social ads

facts.fact: Vendor guidance states industry practice runs roughly $400-$900 per unit per year for stabilized senior living communities, more during lease-up.
facts.quote: Industry practice runs roughly $400-$900 per unit per year for stabilized communities, more during lease-up.

facts.fact: The page states a 60-unit community typically lands at $4,000-$8,000 monthly in paid channels.
facts.quote: A 60-unit community typically lands at $4,000-$8,000 monthly in paid channels.

facts.fact: The page cites move-ins worth $120,000+ in revenue as the basis for resident lifetime value comparison.
facts.quote: with move-ins worth $120,000+ in revenue, most communities under-spend on the trust-building

facts.fact: Streaming TV is quoted by the vendor at $15-35 CPMs for zip-code-targeted local campaigns.
facts.quote: zip-code targeting around your draw radius, $15-35 CPMs, and AI-generated creative

facts.fact: Adwave states it can generate a TV spot from a community's website in about two minutes and place it on 100+ networks in the draw radius.
facts.quote: generate a spot from your community's website in about two minutes and be on 100+ networks in your draw radius this week.

facts.fact: The page states planned-transition senior care decisions take 6-24 months to complete.
facts.quote: Planned transitions** decide over 6-24 months.

facts.fact: The page states awareness channels show tour-volume effects in one to two quarters and full move-in attribution over a year.
facts.quote: awareness channels (TV, social, events) show tour-volume effects in one to two quarters and full move-in attribution over a year.

facts.fact: The page states communities that quit awareness spending at 90 days pay for the restart twice.
facts.quote: Communities that quit awareness spending at 90 days pay for the restart twice.

facts.fact: The page advises that referral relationships and reviews be funded with calendar time on a weekly basis rather than percentage-of-budget dollars.
facts.quote: fund them with calendar time, weekly.

facts.fact: The page says directory placement fees equal to a month's rent on a multi-year stay can still be sound economics in some situations.
facts.quote: A fee equal to a month's rent on a multi-year stay can still be sound economics.

facts.fact: The page advises tracking source-to-move-in conversion weekly for urgent placements.
facts.quote: track source-to-move-in conversion weekly

facts.fact: The page says urgent senior care placements decide in days, while planned transitions decide over 6-24 months.
facts.quote: Urgent placements** (hospital discharge, sudden decline) decide in days.
